description: Anchor-text distribution for a domain or URL, one page at a time: which anchor texts link to it, with backlinks, referring domains, referring pages and dofollow links per anchor. This is what reveals an over-optimised profile (one exact-match commercial phrase dominating) or a hacked one (pharma/casino anchors nobody wrote) — both invisible link by link. CHARGES CREDITS ON THE PAID DATA PROVIDER (~200-500 typical). UNAVAILABLE ON THE DEFAULT FREE DATA PROVIDER, like the rest of the backlinks surface: SEO_DATA_UNAVAILABLE there means the question was never asked, never an empty distribution. There is deliberately no spam-score column — an averaged spam score is not a spam score.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

scope.description: Whether target is a whole domain or one page. Defaults to domain.

target.description: Domain or URL whose inbound anchor texts to list.

name: get_backlink_anchors
